Class BamReader

java.lang.Object
global.thalion.ttio.importers.BamReader
Direct Known Subclasses:
CramReader, SamReader
public class BamReader extends Object
SAM/BAM importer — M87.

Reads SAM and BAM (Sequence Alignment/Map) files into WrittenGenomicRun instances using htsjdk — the pure-Java SAM/BAM/CRAM library used by GATK, Picard, and IGV.

v1.5.0 replaced the prior samtools subprocess implementation so tio-browser works on Windows without requiring a system samtools install. The public API is unchanged; the SamtoolsNotFoundException type is retained as a no-throw historical alias so callers and tests compile unchanged.

Format auto-detection is provided by htsjdk based on magic bytes; one parser handles both SAM and BAM. The companion SamReader (note: name collides with htsjdk.samtools.SamReader — fully qualify if needed) exists as a discoverable convenience alias.

Cross-language equivalents: Python ttio.importers.bam.BamReader, Objective-C TTIOBamReader. The byte-level output is verified by the cross-compat CI job.

(M87, v1.5.0 htsjdk swap)

    • toGenomicRun

      public WrittenGenomicRun toGenomicRun(String name, String region, String sampleName) throws IOException
      Read the BAM/SAM and return a WrittenGenomicRun.
      Parameters:
      name - run name (becomes /study/genomic_runs/<name>).
      region - optional region filter (e.g. "chr1:1000-2000", "chr1", "*" for unmapped); null means no filter.
      sampleName - optional override for sample_name; null means "use first @RG SM:".
      Throws:
      IOException - if the file is missing, malformed, or a region filter is requested against an unindexed file.

    • makeReaderFactory

      protected htsjdk.samtools.SamReaderFactory makeReaderFactory()
      Build the htsjdk reader factory for this importer. Default is the lenient stringency factory suitable for SAM/BAM. CramReader overrides to inject a ReferenceSource so reference- compressed CRAM bytes can be reconstituted.

    • iteratorFor

      protected Iterator<htsjdk.samtools.SAMRecord> iteratorFor(htsjdk.samtools.SamReader reader, String region)
      Resolve a samtools-style region string (null, "*", "chr1", "chr1:1000", "chr1:1000-2000") to an iterator over matching SAMRecords. Subclasses (CramReader in M88) can override to inject a reference for CRAM decode if needed; default implementation handles SAM/BAM.

    • isSamtoolsAvailable

      public static boolean isSamtoolsAvailable()
      Pre-v1.5.0 this probed for samtools on PATH. v1.5.0 onwards BamReader uses htsjdk (a Maven dep, always available), so this unconditionally returns true. Retained for source compat with tests using Assumptions.assumeTrue(isSamtoolsAvailable()).
